blurb: The HasuOS Home settings hub's own icon — a bold white gear on a grey jewel-glass tile, so the 'Home' hub entry and HasuOS Home itself are never mixed up again. Drawn in the family style from the Font Awesome gear glyph; no other app's icon is copied.
bundled_in: HasuOS Home 10.61 as @mipmap/ic_launcher_settings (mdpi 48, hdpi 72, xhdpi 96, xxhdpi 144, xxxhdpi 192)
name: Settings Gear
